headline.validated: Every query differentially validated against Trino 481 on the same StorageGRID Iceberg warehouse, with DuckDB's official dbgen/dsdgen as an independent data oracle.

stats.label: suites faster than Trino at SF1 (Oct 2026)
suites faster at SF10 (Jul 2026), SSB at parity

scales.note: Scale factor ≈ dataset size: SF1 ≈ 1 GB, SF10 ≈ 10 GB. SF1 figures are from the 10 October 2026 sweep against Trino 481. SF10 figures are from the 9 July 2026 run on a dedicated 8-core / 31 GB box, both engines capped at 12 GB; SF10 has not been re-run against Trino since.
scales.dominant: Faster than Trino at SF1 on all eight industry suites, and on six of seven at SF10 as of the July run.
scales.progress: TPC-C's sub-second reads, the one SF1 suite we trailed in July (0.77×), are now 4.9× faster than Trino. At SF10, SSB reached parity (20.4s vs 21.4s) after shipping build-side key sets to workers, and TPC-H (1.7×) and TPC-DS (1.5×) lead. The remaining exception is the bank suite at SF10, where spill degraded under an 8 GB pool in July; the memory-pool and spill fixes from October have not been measured at SF10 yet.
